description: This PHP source file defines the TCPDFEngine class, which extends a PDFEngine class to provide functionality for generating PDF documents using TCPDF within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for writing HTML, headers, footers, configuring PDF options, and outputting the PDF.

classes.name: TCPDFEngine
classes.description: A class extending PDFEngine to generate PDFs using TCPDF, with methods for writing HTML, headers, footers, configuring options, and outputting the final PDF document.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Writes HTML content into the PDF, adding a blank page first if needed.

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to a file or browser, based on the destination parameter.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Sets and writes HTML header content for the PDF.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Sets and writes HTML footer content for the PDF.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Sets CSS styles to be included in the PDF.

methods.name: getCSS
methods.description: Returns combined CSS styles wrapped in style tags.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Adds a blank page to the PDF.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Configures PDF generation options based on included config mapping file and initializes SuiteTCPDF instance.
